branch_scope: GitHub Actions scopes caches by branch: a branch reads its ancestors' caches but writes only its own. A PR's first push starts cold; subsequent pushes to the same PR hit the PR's branch's cache. A PR never writes to main's cache.

specs.note: Stores the extracted sources of every module the repository depends on; keyed on go.sum's hash so that a dependency change invalidates the cache.
Stores compiled object files and intermediate artifacts; keyed on the repository's Go sources and go.sum so that a code change invalidates the cache.
Stores the golangci-lint binary; keyed on the pinned linter version so that a version bump invalidates the cache.
